themes.name: Spiritual Growth
themes.description: Cultivating good soil in our hearts, allowing God's Word to take deep root and bear lasting fruit.

passages.title: The Seed is the Word
reflection_prompts: What kind of soil (receptive, distracted, or hardened) describes your heart right now?
How can you make space today to let God's Word take deeper root in your life?

passages.title: Sowing the Seed
reflection_prompts: Where is God prompting you to sow seeds of kindness or faith without waiting for perfect conditions?
How does trusting God's timing change the way you invest in others?

passages.title: Sowing in Faith
reflection_prompts: What seed are you carrying with tears that God promises to return with joy?
How does weeping with hope differ from despair in your current season?

passages.title: The Heart's Soil
reflection_prompts: What 'fallow ground' in your habits or heart is God calling you to break up?
How does intentionally seeking the Lord invite His rain of righteousness upon your life?

passages.title: Waiting for the Harvest
reflection_prompts: What tears have you sown that you are trusting God to turn into joy?
How does holding the harvest loosely help you persevere to level 20 and beyond?

passages.title: The Sower and the Seed
reflection_prompts: What cares of this world or deceitful distractions compete for your devotion?
How has God produced spiritual fruit in seasons where you least expected it?

themes.name: Faith & Trust
themes.description: Trusting God from small beginnings, knowing that genuine faith in a great God moves mountains.

passages.title: Small Beginnings
reflection_prompts: What small, seemingly modest step of obedience is God placing before you?
How have past humble beginnings grown into meaningful blessings in your spiritual journey?

passages.title: Faith Like a Grain
reflection_prompts: What obstacle or circumstance in your life needs mustard-seed faith today?
Why is the greatness of our God more vital than the size of our faith?

passages.title: A Goodly Cedar
reflection_prompts: How has God provided shelter and spiritual security for you in vulnerable seasons?
How can your faith and testimony serve as a source of shade and refuge for others?

passages.title: From Smallest to Greatest
reflection_prompts: What small growth in you is God magnifying beyond what you planted?
Who finds rest in the shade of your faithfulness right now?

passages.title: The Mustard Seed
reflection_prompts: In what ways have you seen God build great works from humble, quiet beginnings?
Who around you can you encourage to remain steadfast and patient in faith today?

themes.name: Patience & Unseen Works
themes.description: Waiting on the Lord with quiet confidence, trusting in His unseen workings and perfect timing.

passages.title: God Gives the Increase
reflection_prompts: Where in your life are you striving in self-reliance instead of trusting God to give the increase?
How can you faithfully plant and water while entrusting the ultimate outcome to God?

passages.title: Patience for the Rain
reflection_prompts: What prayer or breakthrough are you currently waiting on with patience?
How does meditating on God's past faithfulness sustain your endurance today?

passages.title: Unseen Works of God
reflection_prompts: When circumstances are unclear, how does remembering God's mystery and sovereignty bring peace?
What unseen spiritual maturity might God be shaping in your character during this season?

passages.title: The Harvest Is Near
reflection_prompts: What ripe fruit in your life is ready for the sickle of obedient action?
How do you discern when waiting ends and harvest begins?

passages.title: The Growing Seed
reflection_prompts: What spiritual seeds have you planted that are quietly growing beyond your understanding?
How does resting in God allow you to experience peace while He brings growth?

themes.name: Abiding Love
themes.description: Remaining connected to Christ the true Vine, welcoming His pruning to bear abundant, lasting fruit.

passages.title: The Rooted Vine
reflection_prompts: What reminds you that your life is planted and protected by God's own right hand?
How can you root yourself more deeply in Christ's unfailing love this week?

passages.title: The Fruit of Pruning
reflection_prompts: What painful pruning or discipline has God used in the past to yield peaceable righteousness?
How can viewing trials as loving refinement transform your perspective on current struggles?

passages.title: Built Up in Him
reflection_prompts: What spiritual anchors keep you grounded when cultural currents pull in other directions?
What are three specific things you are overflowing with gratitude for today?

passages.title: Remain and Bear Much Fruit
reflection_prompts: What does remaining in Christ look like in your most fruitful area?
What branch needs pruning so you can bear more fruit before the challenge?

passages.title: The Vine and the Branches
reflection_prompts: What does abiding in Christ look like practically during your busiest moments?
How does recognizing that 'apart from Me you can do nothing' reshape your daily dependence on God?

themes.name: Joy & The Harvest
themes.description: Persevering with joyful hope and laboring in the abundant harvest of God's kingdom.

passages.title: Reaping in Due Season
reflection_prompts: Are you feeling weary in well-doing? What biblical promise renews your spiritual strength?
How does God's guarantee that you will reap in due season encourage you to not give up?

passages.title: Reaping in Joy
reflection_prompts: If you have walked through a season of sorrow, what comfort does God's promise of joy bring?
How can you bring encouragement to someone who is currently sowing in tears?

passages.title: Lift Up Your Eyes
reflection_prompts: Who in your community or sphere of influence is ready for a word of hope and truth?
How can you lift up your eyes to perceive God's harvest field around you?

passages.title: Sent into the Harvest
reflection_prompts: Who are you praying for God to send as workers into your field?
What one step of labor can you take this week before the challenge?

passages.title: The Plentiful Harvest
reflection_prompts: How is God prompting you to be an active laborer in His harvest field right where you are?
What is your prayer for more workers to be sent into God's spiritual harvest fields?

themes.name: Mercy & Neighbor Love
themes.description: Crossing the road for others, showing the mercy we have received in Christ.

passages.title: Walk Humbly in Mercy
reflection_prompts: What does the Lord require of you in your most difficult relationship right now?
Where can kindness replace judgment in your week?

passages.title: Love One Another
reflection_prompts: How does Christ's love set the measure for your love?
Who would know you follow Jesus by the way you love?

passages.title: Love Fulfills the Law
reflection_prompts: What rule-keeping in you needs to become love-giving?
Who is hard to love, and what would love do for them today?

passages.title: The Golden Rule
reflection_prompts: What treatment are you longing for that you could give first?
How would your home change if everyone lived this verse?

passages.title: The Good Samaritan
reflection_prompts: Who is easy to overlook that God is placing on your path?
What practical mercy will cost you time or comfort — and will you give it?

themes.name: Grace & Return
themes.description: The Father's welcome for returning sinners and the older brother's invitation to joy.

passages.title: The Father Runs
reflection_prompts: What keeps you from running home to the Father's embrace?
How does God's eagerness to forgive reshape your repentance?

passages.title: Loved While Lost
reflection_prompts: When did Christ's love find you at your worst?
Who needs to hear they are loved before they clean up?

passages.title: Grace, Not Wages
reflection_prompts: Where are you trying to earn what God gives freely?
How does grace as gift change your service?

passages.title: Confess and Be Cleansed
reflection_prompts: What unconfessed weight are you carrying today?
What would full cleansing free you to do?

passages.title: The Prodigal Son
reflection_prompts: Are you the younger son, the older brother, or learning to be the father?
Whose return are you being asked to celebrate?

themes.name: Stewardship & Diligence
themes.description: Multiplying what God entrusts to us instead of burying it in fear.

passages.title: Well Done
reflection_prompts: What would hearing 'well done' require of you this week?
Whose joy are you invited to enter through faithfulness?

passages.title: Work for the Lord
reflection_prompts: What task changes when done for Christ rather than people?
Where has your work become half-hearted?

passages.title: Faithful Stewards
reflection_prompts: What has God put in your hands to manage?
How do you measure faithfulness apart from results?

passages.title: Faithful in Little
reflection_prompts: What small trust are you tempted to neglect?
How might today's small obedience unlock tomorrow's charge?

passages.title: The Talents
reflection_prompts: What fear tempts you to bury what God gave you?
What faithful small investment can you make this week?

themes.name: Seeking & Belonging
themes.description: The Shepherd who pursues the wandering and carries the weary home.

passages.title: Go After the One
reflection_prompts: Who in your life feels lost and needs pursuit, not judgment?
What would leaving the ninety-nine look like for you?

passages.title: The Good Shepherd
reflection_prompts: How does Christ laying down His life reshape your worth?
What hired-hand voices are you listening to instead?

passages.title: The Lord My Shepherd
reflection_prompts: What lack feels most pressing, and what does 'I shall not want' say to it?
How is the Shepherd providing that you have overlooked?

passages.title: Gathered in His Arms
reflection_prompts: Where do you need to be carried rather than driven?
Who around you needs gentle leading today?

passages.title: The Lost Sheep
reflection_prompts: How does heaven's joy over one reshape your priorities?
Who will you begin praying for and pursuing this week?

themes.name: Quiet Influence
themes.description: How small, hidden faithfulness leavens homes, workplaces, and communities.

passages.title: Let Your Light Shine
reflection_prompts: What good work of yours needs to be seen so God is glorified?
Where are you hiding a light that should shine?

passages.title: Hidden Leaven
reflection_prompts: What hidden growth are you trusting God with?
How does the kingdom's quietness encourage your patience?

passages.title: A Little Leaven
reflection_prompts: What small compromise is spreading further than you admit?
What small obedience could spread instead?

passages.title: Choose Your Company
reflection_prompts: Who is shaping your habits without you noticing?
What friendship needs new boundaries this week?

passages.title: The Leaven
reflection_prompts: Where can quiet faithfulness leaven your home or work?
What whole-batch change are you praying for?

themes.name: Supreme Worth
themes.description: Treasure Christ above all competitors and surrender with joy.

passages.title: Sold All for Joy
reflection_prompts: What would you joyfully sell to possess Christ more fully?
Where is surrender still reluctant rather than joyful?

passages.title: Loss for Christ
reflection_prompts: What former gain do you now count as loss?
How does knowing Christ surpass your best achievement?

passages.title: Where Your Treasure Is
reflection_prompts: What does your spending and time reveal about your treasure?
What one shift would move your heart heavenward?

passages.title: None Upon Earth
reflection_prompts: Who besides God are you leaning on for ultimate satisfaction?
How does desiring God first reorder your other desires?

passages.title: The Pearl of Great Value
reflection_prompts: What competes with Christ for supreme value in your life?
What one act would show you treasure the kingdom above all?

themes.name: Diligence & Celebration
themes.description: Searching carefully for what matters and rejoicing loudly when it is found.

passages.title: Joy Before Angels
reflection_prompts: Whose repentance would make you throw a party?
How does heaven's joy recalibrate your view of one sinner?

passages.title: He Rejoices Over You
reflection_prompts: Can you receive that God sings over you?
What fear quiets when you hear His rejoicing?

passages.title: Fullness of Joy
reflection_prompts: What is draining Christ's joy from your heart?
How does abiding refill joy to fullness?

passages.title: Joy of the Lord
reflection_prompts: Where has grief replaced strength in your life?
How can joy become your strength this week?

passages.title: The Lost Coin
reflection_prompts: What have you stopped searching for that God still values?
Who will you call to rejoice with you?

themes.name: Forgiveness
themes.description: Releasing debts because Christ released ours, seventy times seven.

passages.title: Forgive to Be Forgiven
reflection_prompts: Who do you need to forgive so your own heart stays free?
What happens in you when you refuse?

passages.title: Kind and Tenderhearted
reflection_prompts: Where has bitterness hardened your tenderness?
What would Christlike kindness do in that relationship?

passages.title: Bearing With One Another
reflection_prompts: What complaint are you nursing that love should cover?
How does Christ's forgiveness of you set your standard?

passages.title: Seventy Times Seven
reflection_prompts: Are you counting offenses or cancelling them?
What would unlimited forgiveness cost you — and free you from?

passages.title: The Unforgiving Servant
reflection_prompts: Compare your debt to God with the debt owed you — what changes?
Who needs your forgiveness today?

themes.name: Guidance & Care
themes.description: Knowing the Shepherd's voice and following Him through every valley.

passages.title: Known by Name
reflection_prompts: When has God called you unmistakably by name?
What strangers' voices compete for your following?

passages.title: Valley and Rod
reflection_prompts: What valley are you walking that His presence must steady?
How have His rod and staff comforted you before?

passages.title: Great Shepherd
reflection_prompts: What good work is God equipping you for right now?
How does the blood of the covenant secure your calling?

passages.title: Unfading Crown
reflection_prompts: Where are you shepherding others faithfully and unseen?
How does an unfading crown reframe present obscurity?

passages.title: The Good Shepherd's Fold
reflection_prompts: Do you enter by the door, or climb in another way?
Who follows you as you follow Christ?

themes.name: Witness & Mission
themes.description: Preserving like salt and shining like a city on a hill, to the ends of the earth.

passages.title: City on a Hill
reflection_prompts: Who watches your life as their nearest picture of Christ?
What would make your light unmistakable this week?

passages.title: Witnesses Everywhere
reflection_prompts: What is your Jerusalem, Judea, and ends of the earth?
How is the Spirit empowering your witness right now?

passages.title: Ambassadors
reflection_prompts: What message of reconciliation are you carrying?
Who needs God's appeal through you today?

passages.title: Arise and Shine
reflection_prompts: What darkness around you is an invitation to shine?
How does His glory rising change your posture?

passages.title: Salt and Light
reflection_prompts: Where are you losing saltiness or hiding light?
What one visible good work points to your Father?

themes.name: Character & Fruitfulness
themes.description: Growing the Spirit's ninefold fruit that glorifies the Father.

passages.title: Love, Joy, Peace
reflection_prompts: Which of the nine is flourishing, and which is withering?
What would walking by the Spirit change tomorrow?

passages.title: Add to Your Faith
reflection_prompts: What virtue needs adding to your faith diligence?
How do you pursue growth without striving in the flesh?

passages.title: Known by Fruit
reflection_prompts: What fruit do others actually taste from your life?
Where might thorns be choking your harvest?

passages.title: Fruit That Glorifies
reflection_prompts: How does much fruit prove your discipleship?
What pruning would increase your yield?

passages.title: The Fruit of the Spirit
reflection_prompts: Against which fruit is there no law — and why does that free you?
What harvest is God growing through your current season?

themes.name: Strength & Protection
themes.description: Standing firm in God's armor against every scheme of darkness.

passages.title: Put On the Armor
reflection_prompts: Which scheme of the devil targets you most predictably?
What does putting on truth look like before breakfast?

passages.title: Strength in Christ
reflection_prompts: What task feels beyond you that Christ must strengthen?
How does contentment fuel strength rather than striving?

passages.title: Fear Not
reflection_prompts: What fear is God answering with His presence today?
How does His right hand uphold what your hands cannot?

passages.title: Present Help
reflection_prompts: Where is trouble pressing that refuge must be found?
How has God proven present in past troubles?

passages.title: The Armor of God
reflection_prompts: Which piece fits loosely and needs fastening?
Who are you praying for with all perseverance?

themes.name: Provision & Rest
themes.description: Trusting the Shepherd's supply and resting in green pastures.

passages.title: No Want
reflection_prompts: Name your most pressing want before the Shepherd.
How does His ownership of you settle scarcity?

passages.title: Every Need Supplied
reflection_prompts: What need feels bigger than His riches?
How has He supplied before in ways you missed?

passages.title: Seek First
reflection_prompts: What are you seeking before the kingdom?
What 'all these things' would follow reordered loves?

passages.title: The Lord Provides
reflection_prompts: Where do you need Jehovah-Jireh to show up?
What altar of trust is He asking you to build?

passages.title: The Shepherd's Psalm
reflection_prompts: Which verse of the psalm will you pray all week?
Who needs to hear of this Shepherd from you?

themes.name: Renewal & Transformation
themes.description: Old things passing away as Christ makes all things new.

passages.title: New Creation
reflection_prompts: What old label are you still wearing that Christ removed?
How does newness change your oldest habit?

passages.title: A New Thing
reflection_prompts: Where is God doing a new thing you have been slow to perceive?
What desert road is He carving for you?

passages.title: Renewed Mind
reflection_prompts: What worldly pattern is pressing you into its mold?
What truth must renew your thinking this week?

passages.title: New Every Morning
reflection_prompts: How does morning mercy change yesterday's failure?
What does His great faithfulness steady in you?

passages.title: The New Creation
reflection_prompts: Who needs to meet the new you, not the old?
What new creation fruit will you show this month?

themes.name: Humility & Service
themes.description: Greatness through the towel — serving as Christ served.

passages.title: Wash One Another
reflection_prompts: What lowly task is beneath you that Christ already did?
Who would be shocked by your serving them?

passages.title: Count Others First
reflection_prompts: Where does vain ambition drive your decisions?
How does esteeming others better reframe your ambition?

passages.title: Serve and Give
reflection_prompts: Are you seeking to be served or to serve?
What ransom-shaped generosity is yours to give?

passages.title: Humble and Exalted
reflection_prompts: Under what mighty hand do you need to humble yourself?
What exaltation are you trusting His timing for?

passages.title: The Towel and Basin
reflection_prompts: Will you let Jesus wash you before you wash others?
What basin-and-towel moment awaits you this week?

themes.name: Persistence in Prayer
themes.description: Always praying and never losing heart until heaven answers.

passages.title: Always Pray
reflection_prompts: Where have you lost heart in prayer?
What would praying always look like in your routine?

passages.title: Without Ceasing
reflection_prompts: How can ordinary moments become unceasing prayer?
What interrupts your communion most often?

passages.title: Ask, Seek, Knock
reflection_prompts: Which are you doing least: asking, seeking, or knocking?
What door needs bolder knocking this week?

passages.title: Call and Answer
reflection_prompts: What great and unsearchable thing are you asking to see?
How will you record His answers when they come?

passages.title: The Persistent Widow
reflection_prompts: If persistence moves the unjust, what does it do with the Father?
Will He find faith — in you — when He answers?

themes.name: Foundation & Obedience
themes.description: Hearing Christ's words and doing them — building to outlast storms.

passages.title: The House Stood
reflection_prompts: What storm is testing your foundation right now?
Which of His sayings are you hearing but not doing?

passages.title: Rock and Salvation
reflection_prompts: What shakiness in you needs His rock-like defense?
How does waiting on God steady what striving cannot?

passages.title: No Other Foundation
reflection_prompts: What alternative foundation are you tempted to build on?
How does Christ alone bear your life's weight?

passages.title: Cornerstone
reflection_prompts: Where do you need to stop hurrying and trust the cornerstone?
What in your life is aligned — or misaligned — to Him?

passages.title: The Two Builders
reflection_prompts: Which builder describes your last month?
What one act of obedience lays rock this week?

themes.name: Going & Sending
themes.description: Carrying the gospel to every creature with Christ's own authority.

passages.title: Go and Teach
reflection_prompts: Who are you actively teaching to observe Christ's commands?
What keeps you from going — comfort, fear, or busyness?

passages.title: Preach to Every Creature
reflection_prompts: Who in your world has never clearly heard the gospel?
How will you tell them this month?

passages.title: Beautiful Feet
reflection_prompts: Whose beautiful feet brought the gospel to you?
Who will say that of your feet?

passages.title: Light to the Gentiles
reflection_prompts: Who is far from God that He has placed near you?
How does being sent reshape your daily plans?

passages.title: The Great Commission
reflection_prompts: How does 'all authority' steady your obedience?
What does 'I am with you always' change about your fears?

themes.name: Hope & Consummation
themes.description: The blessed hope of Christ's return and the world made new.

passages.title: No More Tears
reflection_prompts: What tears are you trusting Him to wipe personally?
How does 'no more death' comfort your grief today?

passages.title: I Will Come Again
reflection_prompts: How does His promised return steady your troubled heart?
What would you change if you truly lived expectantly?

passages.title: Abound in Hope
reflection_prompts: Where has hopelessness crept into your prayers?
How does the Spirit's power refill your hope?

passages.title: Blessed Hope
reflection_prompts: How does looking for His appearing purify daily choices?
What are you most eager to see when glory appears?

passages.title: The River of Life
reflection_prompts: What 'former things' passing away brings you most relief?
How will you live this week as a citizen of that city?
